mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters are not followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply-side disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met but are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% in 1 month are followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified conditions are met but are followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for three consecutive months are not followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
